# Observables and probes

Built-in observables are the operators in `h.observables`; solvers report their expectation
values as `result.observables[name]`. The definitions are in `OBSERVABLE_DOCS`
(`src/qdjj_solver/common/models.py`); conventions and transformations are explained in
[models](../models.md#built-in-observables).

| Name | Definition | Availability | Units |
|---|---|---|---|
| `impurity_charge` | Total physical impurity electron occupation | Every `Impurity` | Electron count; multiply by $-e$ for the electric charge |
| `impurity_spin_z` | Sum of $(n_\uparrow-n_\downarrow)/2$ over the impurity orbitals | Every `Impurity` | Units of $\hbar$ |
| `double_occupancy_0` | $n_{0\uparrow}n_{0\downarrow}$; further orbitals use `_1`, `_2`, ... | Every `Impurity`, one per orbital | Dimensionless probability |
| `phase_derivative` | $\partial H/\partial\phi$ of a reference junction; in general the derivative along the supplied `phase_velocities` of `make_model` | Reference junctions, or nonzero `phase_velocities` | Energy per radian; the current is $2e/\hbar$ times its expectation value |
| `rho_ws_derivative` | $\partial H/\partial(\rho W_S)$ | Reference junctions, including `rho_ws=0` | Energy |

## Probes

Probe names accepted by `matrix_elements` and by `Hamiltonian.probe` and
`PeriodicHamiltonian.probe` (`PROBE_DOCS` in `src/qdjj_solver/common/probes.py`). The
spin-flip and single-electron probes, and `charge` and `spin_z` when `orbital` is given, act on
one impurity orbital (`orbital`, default 0) and need an uncompressed model; any other name
selects a model observable.

| Probe | Operator | Typical use |
|---|---|---|
| `current` | $\partial H/\partial\phi$ (observable `phase_derivative`), with its drive harmonics | Flux or phase probe; supercurrent |
| `charge` | $n_d$ (observable `impurity_charge`) | Gate probe |
| `spin_z` | $S^z_d$ (observable `impurity_spin_z`) | Longitudinal spin probe |
| `spin_x` | $S^x_d=(S^+_d+S^-_d)/2$ | Transverse spin resonance |
| `spin_y` | $S^y_d=(S^+_d-S^-_d)/(2\mathrm{i})$ | Transverse spin resonance |
| `spin_plus` | $S^+_d=d^\dagger_\uparrow d_\downarrow$ | Spin raising |
| `spin_minus` | $S^-_d=d^\dagger_\downarrow d_\uparrow$ | Spin lowering |
| `d_up` | $d_\uparrow$ | Electron removal (tunnelling spectroscopy) |
| `d_dn` | $d_\downarrow$ | Electron removal (tunnelling spectroscopy) |
| `d_up_dagger` | $d^\dagger_\uparrow$ | Electron addition (tunnelling spectroscopy) |
| `d_dn_dagger` | $d^\dagger_\downarrow$ | Electron addition (tunnelling spectroscopy) |
